assessment_summary: Step 0002 claims that the objects of CLat (complete lattices) form a subcollection of the objects of Frm (frames). This is false: a frame is a complete lattice satisfying the infinite distributive law, so the objects of Frm form a subcollection of the objects of CLat, not the other way around. Not every complete lattice is a frame (e.g., non-distributive complete lattices). Therefore, the claim in 0002 is invalid.
